message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine, dated "17-23 NOVEMBER 2014," depicts a man on a red and white lattice telecommunications tower. The tower, positioned on the right, features several white circular parabolic antennas. The man, wearing a dark blue and grey jumpsuit and cap, is attached to the tower with his left arm while reaching out with his right towards a white cloth billowing in the sky to the left. This cloth features a blue and yellow logo with the inverted word "Telkom Indonesia."

The background is a solid light blue. Bold black and red text in the lower left reads, "MAIN MENARA BEKAS TIM SUKSES." Below this, a smaller paragraph in black reads, "Bekas anggota Tim Transisi Jokowi mengambil alih bisnis tower seluler anak perusahaan PT Telkom. Perusahaan negara itu ditengarai bakal rugi besar." The top of the cover lists three news headlines: "MENTERI SUSI: ADA YANG INGIN SAYA MAMPUS," "GRUSA-GRUSU KARTU SAKTI JOKOWI," and "CUCI UANG KORUPSI TRANSJAKARTA." A barcode and the price "RP 35.000" are in the bottom-left corner.
